title: Traces tab lists the correlated trace and opens embedded TraceDetails over the indexed window
verifies: a session whose events carry a trace id lists exactly one correlated trace in the Traces tab (count badge '1' + one row) and clicking it opens the embedded TraceDetails

title: Event drawer 'View Trace' navigates to standalone trace details over the indexed window
verifies: a related resource with a trace id shows the View Trace button, and clicking it opens /traces/trace-details in a new tab with the canonical padded trace id and an indexed window wider than the ±10s guess

title: Traces tab shows the empty state when the session has no trace ids
verifies: a session whose events carry no trace id renders the 'no correlated traces' empty state and no table

title: Legacy zero-stripped trace id is normalized and still correlates
verifies: a trace id stored zero-stripped in _rumdata is padded to 32 hex and still resolves to the matching backend trace

title: Trace id present but no backend trace is filtered out of the list
verifies: a trace id with no matching backend trace is filtered out of the Traces tab, leaving the empty state
